Recipe: validate a query response.description:
Validate a response at the boundary so malformed data fails as a query error instead of reaching the component. Requires useQuery from @tanstack/vue-query and a Zod schema.

在边界处校验响应，让格式不符的数据以查询错误的形式失败，而不是流入组件；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useQuery 与一个 Zod schema。
